title: No test proves that opening a check-in link alone records no visit
what: Every check-in test opens the poster link and then taps Check in. None opens the link, leaves it or taps Not now, and then checks that the gym has no visit for the day. A link forwarded into a WhatsApp group is the case that matters, and the Not now button is never pressed at all.
expected: A test opens the check-in link, taps Not now (or goes back), and checks the gym recorded no visit and the Gym tab opened.
fix_line: Add a phone test that opens the link, taps Not now, and checks no visit was written

title: Switching from one gym to another is never tested for the old gym's logo
what: The Gym tab draws the gym's logo only while the saved look belongs to the joined gym. No test switches a phone from gym A to gym B and checks that gym A's logo and name never show over gym B's tab. The look tests only change the same gym.
expected: A test joins gym A, switches to gym B, and checks the header shows gym B's name and never gym A's logo.
fix_line: Add a test that switches gyms and checks the header shows only the new gym

title: The ask to send workouts to the gym is never tested on a screen
what: Only the reading of the gym's ask, the words for refusals and the file the phone builds are tested, plus the server. No test shows the ask, taps Yes or No, or checks 'Sending your report…', the green 'Report sent to the gym.', the red no-internet line, or the Try again path after the yes reached the gym but the file did not. Nothing checks one report per ask from the phone.
